title: Public transport concessions for asylum seekers
summary: This page provides information about public transport concessions available for asylum seekers in New South Wales.
who_can_apply: Asylum seekers are eligible for information regarding public transport concessions.

faqs.q: Where can asylum seekers find information about transport concessions?
faqs.a: Information regarding concessions for asylum seekers can be found on the Transport for NSW website.

faqs.q: Are there specific tickets for regional travel?
faqs.a: Yes, tickets such as Regional Excursion Daily (RED) tickets and Country Pensioner Excursion (CPE) tickets are available.

faqs.q: Do concessions apply when travelling interstate?
faqs.a: Concession fares, including sleeping berths, are available when travelling on interstate train services, but entitlements vary by state.
